explication: jadx-headless-mcp is a headless Android static-analysis server that exposes JADX through MCP. An MCP client starts the server, loads an APK/DEX/JAR into a managed session, then invokes tools to inspect metadata, classes, methods, searches, references, and resources. The main runtime layers are tool registration, session lifecycle/configuration, and the JADX-backed analysis engine. README documents the capability set; sampled source and the SOURCE INDEX support the shown wiring, while unsampled tool implementations are represented by their exact source paths.
